scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and standard-library numerical consistency checker; no independent audit or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only real scalar periodic BV with full circular total variation and classical Gaussian heat smoothing.
All-time sharp norm and arc extremizer class are proved, but uniqueness of the finite-time maximizing arc length is not claimed.
Small-time constants and convergence are analytic; numerical checks are finite corroborations rather than independent proofs.
Historical priority remains contingent on earlier work not indexed in the sources reviewed.
title: Microscopic two-jump extremizers for sharp periodic heat approximation of bounded-variation functions
